args.question: Provide the cardholder statement regarding this transaction.

args.narrative: The transaction was authorised on 2026-01-24 for 7458 USD. AVS matched (Y) and CVV matched (M). The device and IP used match the cardholder device on record. The goods were delivered by USPS on 2026-02-03.

args.explanation: Read the case and all five evidence documents (receipt, authorization, AVS/CVV match Y/M, device and IP match, USPS delivery). Requested cardholder statement (denies purchase). Represented on 2026-02-03 with all five; the case moved to pre_arbitration. I then waited 30 days without checking the status after represent, and the pre-arbitration deadline was missed on 2026-02-24, so the case resolved against the merchant with 7458 refunded. This was my error: I should have checked status and the pre-arbitration deadline right after representing and acted within it.
